d:
Team India suffered a humiliating 244-run defeat against New Zealand in the 4th ODI as the Indian batting lineup completely collapsed while chasing a target of 334 runs.
India were bowled out for just 89 runs in 26.4 overs. Matt Henry was the star with the ball, picking up 6 wickets for just 27 runs. Rohit Sharma, Virat Kohli and Shreyas Iyer were all dismissed for ducks, exposing India's struggles against movement and pace.
But is this defeat just a bad day at the office, or does it expose a bigger problem with India's batting lineup?
